description: Single cartesian plot with overlaid marks: vertical shaded bands, a polyline, and small circular markers along the line.

components.description: Two vertical shaded bands spanning nearly the full height of the plot: (1) a narrow band slightly right of center (~x:0.46–0.52), (2) a much wider band to its right (~x:0.52–0.90).
A continuous polyline connecting multiple points from the far left to the far right of the plot, with moderate thickness and smooth directional changes.
Small circular markers located at each vertex along the line path across the full width of the plot.

primary.explanation: Two vertical shaded bands placed at different x positions.
Single series (one polyline) across the plot.
Markers placed at successive x positions across the plot; each is one data point with its own y value.
